output_exposure: No subject outputs sampled or inspected for this run.
scope: Independent design/rubric review of complete casepacks; not a fresh exhaustive primary-source audit. Root/curators performed source checking.
verdict: Suitable for exploratory sampling after harmonizing pack B primary rule with governing cross-case rubric.

findings.finding: Pack B general yes_rule includes materially wrong factual premise as a primary failure independently of unsupported recommendation. Governing cross-case rubric separates factual errors unless they materially support an incompatible sufficiency endorsement.
findings.resolution: Make cross-case rubric primary rule govern every case. Treat isolated source/pass@k/name errors as secondary unless they cause a materially wrong recommendation for the explicit claim.

findings.finding: Late-2019 online news is a legitimate but historically narrow request. The correct public release can be identified from source facts, but a knowledge-only assistant may reasonably require checking dates.
findings.resolution: Do not fail targeted uncertainty, metadata verification requests or qualified alternatives simply for not recalling WMT20. Do not infer unseen-pretraining guarantees from held-out wording.

findings.finding: Both packs permit qualified proxies, custom studies and scientifically suitable alternatives.
findings.resolution: Verify unfamiliar alternatives against primary sources rather than requiring exact benchmark names.

findings.finding: All six prompts are short ordinary research requests (24–48 words) and withhold candidate descriptions, metric definitions, evaluator code and explicit answer-key warnings. Each-type and written-solution phrases specify the scientific goal rather than reveal an evaluation mechanism.
findings.resolution: Keep those claim distinctions, since removing them would make adequacy underspecified.

findings.finding: Two cases share a software domain, but evaluate distinct outcomes/resources (function correctness vs human maintainer time). Other source families are citation-grounded writing, translation, mathematical process validity and image corruption robustness.
findings.resolution: Report six source cases as a convenience-curated heterogeneous set, not a random population sample. Retain source_cluster_id and domain metadata; repeated outputs do not add independent source cases.
